integrity.mathematical_evidence: Explicit two-step rational Jacobian with infinity norm 13/64<1, exact swap identities and min-max squeezing for constant dispersal.
integrity.reproduction: Run python verify.py; no external Python dependencies.
integrity.scope_of_checks: Computational checks support rather than replace analytic proofs.

scientific_limitations: The two-cycle is locally attracting; its global basin and other attractors are not characterized.
The density-dependent migration rule is an admissible monotone C1 construction rather than a calibrated empirical curve.
The comparison applies to two identical Beverton-Holt recruitment maps with symmetric loss and constant migration.
Priority remains best-knowledge: a closely related 2018 two-patch article was not accessible in full text.
title: Robust antiphase oscillations generated by density-dependent dispersal with Beverton–Holt recruitment
